```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

pit_stops <- read.csv("data/ergast/pit_stops.csv")
qualifying <- read.csv("data/ergast/qualifying.csv")
races <- read.csv("data/ergast/races.csv")
results <- read.csv("data/ergast/results.csv")
seasons <- read.csv("data/ergast/seasons.csv")
sprint_results <- read.csv("data/ergast/sprint_results.csv")
status <- read.csv("data/ergast/status.csv")
circuits <- read.csv("data/ergast/circuits.csv")
constructor_results <- read.csv("data/ergast/constructor_results.csv")
constructor_standings <- read.csv("data/ergast/constructor_standings.csv")
constructors <- read.csv("data/ergast/constructors.csv")
driver_standings <- read.csv("data/ergast/driver_standings.csv")
drivers <- read.csv("data/ergast/drivers.csv")
lap_times <- read.csv("data/ergast/lap_times.csv")

##สภาพอากาศ ล่าสุด
weather <- read.csv("data/weather_circuit.csv")  # NOTE: assemble from data/weather/ (see README)

f1_dat <- left_join(left_join(left_join(results, races, "raceId"), drivers, "driverId") |>
                      select(resultId, constructorId, position, positionOrder, grid, points,
                             raceId, year, round, circuitId, name, date, `time.y`, statusId,
                             driverId, driverRef, dob, nationality), circuits, "circuitId")

f1_dat <- left_join(f1_dat, constructors, "constructorId")

f1_dat <- f1_dat |> filter(year >= 2010)

### "Car #2 (Logan Sargeant, Williams) withdrawn." 
### william ถอนนักขับออกก่อนแข่ง ทำให้ 2024 round 3 คนหายไป 1 ผลทั้งหมดเหลือ 2559 (2560 - 1)

f1_dat2 <- f1_dat %>%
  
  arrange(year, round, positionOrder) %>%
  
  mutate(
    date        = as.Date(date),
    dob         = as.Date(dob),
    Constructor = name,
    Age         = as.numeric(floor(time_length(interval(dob, date), "years"))),
    Nationality = nationality.x
  ) %>%
  
  # 4) Driver Experience (ไม่เปลี่ยน)
  group_by(driverId) %>%
  arrange(year, round, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    Driver_Experience = row_number() - 1,
    Driver_Podium     = lag(cumsum(positionOrder %in% 1:3), default = 0),
    Prev_Total_Points = lag(cumsum(points), default = 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  # 6) Driver + Constructor Experience (ไม่เปลี่ยน)
  group_by(driverId, constructorId) %>%
  arrange(year, round, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    Driver_Constructor_Exp = row_number() - 1
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 5) Constructor Wins — แยก pipe ออกมาทำหลัง ==================
constructor_wins_tbl <- f1_dat2 %>%
  group_by(constructorId, raceId, year, round) %>%
  summarise(
    team_podium_this_race = sum(positionOrder %in% 1:3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(constructorId) %>%
  arrange(year, round, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    Constructor_Wins = lag(cumsum(team_podium_this_race), default = 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(constructorId, raceId, Constructor_Wins)

f1_dat2 <- f1_dat2 %>%
  left_join(constructor_wins_tbl, by = c("constructorId", "raceId"))


# หาแถวที่เป็น header รอบสอง
split_row <- which(weather$location_id == "location_id")

# แยกตาราง
location_table <- weather[1:(split_row - 1),
                          c("location_id", "latitude", "longitude",
                            "elevation", "utc_offset_seconds", "timezone")]
location_table$circuitId <- circuits$circuitId

weather_table <- weather[(split_row + 1):nrow(weather), ]

# ตั้งชื่อคอลัมน์จาก header แถวที่ซ้ำ
colnames(weather_table) <- weather[split_row, ]

# ลบแถว header ออก (ถ้ายังติดมาด้วย)
weather_table <- weather_table[-1, ]

# แปลงชนิดข้อมูล
weather_table$location_id <- as.numeric(weather_table$location_id)
weather_table$temperature <- as.numeric(weather_table$`temperature_2m (°C)`)
weather_table$rain <- as.numeric(weather_table$`rain (mm)`)
weather_table$wind_speed <- as.numeric(weather_table$`wind_speed_10m (km/h)`)
weather_table$weather_time <- as.POSIXct(weather_table$time, format = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M")

# ดูผลลัพธ์
head(location_table)
head(weather_table)

weather_table <- weather_table[, colnames(weather_table) != ""]
weather_circuit <- weather_table %>%
  left_join(mutate(location_table,
                   location_id = as.numeric(location_id)),
            by = "location_id")

weather_circuit  <-  left_join(weather_circuit, circuits, "circuitId") |> 
  select(location_id, 
         circuitId,
         circuitRef,
         weather_time,
         temperature,
         rain,
         wind_speed,
         latitude,
         longitude,
         lat,
         lng)

str(f1_dat2)
str(weather_circuit)


total_race_time <- lap_times %>%
  group_by(raceId) %>%
  mutate(race_laps = max(lap)) %>%          # จำนวนรอบของ race
  group_by(raceId, driverId) %>%
  summarise(
    total_ms = sum(milliseconds, na.rm = TRUE),
    laps_completed = max(lap),
    race_laps = max(race_laps),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(laps_completed == race_laps) %>%   # เอาเฉพาะคนที่วิ่งครบ
  group_by(raceId) %>%
  summarise(
    race_time_ms = max(total_ms),           
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    hours = race_time_ms %/% (1000 * 60 * 60),
    minutes = (race_time_ms %% (1000 * 60 * 60)) %/% (1000 * 60),
    seconds = (race_time_ms %% (1000 * 60)) / 1000,
    time_hms = sprintf("%02d:%02d:%06.3f", hours, minutes, seconds)
  )

## ตัวแปร dnf
f1_dat2 <- left_join(f1_dat2, status, by = "statusId")


f1_dat2 <- left_join(f1_dat2, total_race_time, by = "raceId")

# 1️⃣ สร้างเวลาเริ่มและเวลาจบการแข่งขัน
f1_dat2_time <- f1_dat2 %>%
  mutate(
    race_start = ymd(date) + hms(time.y),
    race_end   = race_start + milliseconds(race_time_ms)
  )

# 2️⃣ แปลง weather_time ให้เป็น datetime
weather_circuit2 <- weather_circuit %>%
  mutate(weather_time = ymd_hms(weather_time))

# 3️⃣ Join แล้วกรองช่วงเวลาแข่งขัน
weather_avg <- f1_dat2_time %>%
  select(raceId, circuitId, race_start, race_end) %>%
  distinct() %>%   # เอา race ซ้ำออกก่อน
  left_join(weather_circuit2,
            by = "circuitId",
            relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  filter(weather_time >= race_start,
         weather_time <= race_end) %>%
  group_by(raceId) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_temperature = mean(temperature, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_rain        = mean(rain, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_wind_speed  = mean(wind_speed, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# 4️⃣ Join กลับเข้า dataset หลัก
f1_dat2 <- f1_dat2 %>%
  left_join(weather_avg, by = "raceId")

str(f1_dat2)


f1_dat2 <- f1_dat2 %>%
  mutate(
    is_finished = status == "Finished" |
      grepl("^\\+\\d+ Lap", status),
    DNF_flag = ifelse(is_finished, 0, 1)
  )

constructor_race <- f1_dat2 %>%
  group_by(constructorId, raceId, year, round) %>%
  summarise(
    team_DNF = ifelse(any(DNF_flag == 1), 1, 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(year, round)

constructor_race <- constructor_race %>%
  group_by(constructorId) %>%
  arrange(year, round, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    total_races_before = row_number() - 1,
    cum_DNF_before = lag(cumsum(team_DNF), default = 0),
    Constructor_DNF_Score = ifelse(
      total_races_before == 0,
      0,
      cum_DNF_before / total_races_before
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


f1_dat2 <- f1_dat2 %>%
  left_join(
    constructor_race %>%
      select(constructorId, raceId, Constructor_DNF_Score),
    by = c("constructorId", "raceId")
  )

overtake_data <- lap_times %>%
  arrange(raceId, driverId, lap) %>%
  group_by(raceId, driverId) %>%
  mutate(
    pos_gain = lag(position) - position,
    pos_gain = ifelse(pos_gain > 0, pos_gain, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(raceId) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Overtakes = sum(pos_gain, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Laps = max(lap),
    Overtake_Rate = Total_Overtakes / Total_Laps,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

overtake_circuits <- left_join(f1_dat2 ,overtake_data ,by = "raceId") |>
  select(raceId,
         Total_Overtakes,
         Total_Laps,
         Overtake_Rate,
         circuitId,
         `name.x`,
         circuitRef,
         location,
         year,
         round)

overtake_for_cluster <- overtake_circuits |>
```

```{r}
library(randomForest)

final_table_with_cluster$score_group <- as.factor(final_table_with_cluster$score_group)


train_df <- final_table_with_cluster |> 
  filter(year < 2024, round %in% c(1:20)) |>
  select(-year,-grid)
  
test_df <- final_table_with_cluster |> 
  filter(year == 2024, round %in% c(3)) |>
  select(-year,-grid)


rf_model <- randomForest(score_group ~ ., 
                         data = train_df,
                         ntree = 1000,
                         mtry = 5)

rf_prob <- predict(rf_model, newdata = test_df, type = "prob")


rf_prob
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# รวม predictions กับ probability
rf_pred_df <- test_df %>%
  mutate(pred_no_point = rf_prob[, "no_point"],
         pred_podium   = rf_prob[, "podium"],
         pred_scoring  = rf_prob[, "scoring"])

# กำหนดจำนวนสูงสุดตามที่ต้องการ
max_no_point <- 10    # class 1
max_podium   <- 3    # class 2
max_scoring  <- 7   # class 3

# สร้าง vector สำหรับ final prediction
final_pred <- rep(NA, nrow(rf_pred_df))

# 1️⃣ เลือก podium ก่อน
podium_idx <- order(rf_pred_df$pred_podium, decreasing = TRUE)
final_pred[podium_idx[1:max_podium]] <- "podium"

# 2️⃣ เลือก scoring (ไม่ทับ podium)
scoring_idx <- order(rf_pred_df$pred_scoring, decreasing = TRUE)
scoring_idx <- setdiff(scoring_idx, podium_idx[1:max_podium])
final_pred[scoring_idx[1:max_scoring]] <- "scoring"

# 3️⃣ สุดท้ายเลือก no_point (ไม่ทับทั้งสอง)
no_point_idx <- order(rf_pred_df$pred_no_point, decreasing = TRUE)
no_point_idx <- setdiff(no_point_idx, c(podium_idx[1:max_podium],
                                        scoring_idx[1:max_scoring]))
final_pred[no_point_idx[1:max_no_point]] <- "no_point"

# เพิ่ม column final_class
rf_pred_df$final_class <- final_pred

# ดู confusion table
table(rf_pred_df$final_class, rf_pred_df$score_group)
```
